reviews.text: Today was Lupita first day at dogs day ! She had a blast ! Thank you so much

Summer LOVES dog days! They post cute pics of the dogs on their Facebook priv group for members! I’m so sad I moved to LA as I’m trying to find a daycare of the same caliber! Summer will definitely be back when I’m down in San Diego! Staff are so friendly + it’s a place I do not worry one bit about my dogs safety. They are so attentive
This place has been a blessing.  They take great care of the dogs, Whether you’re doing daycare or overnight boarding.  A+ with our Dog Olive.
Bernard approved doggie day camp! He absolutely loves coming here and getting to play with all his friends. This non water liking pupster has even ventured through the centers cooling pools!
I t Took my dog here for daycare and he got extremely badly sick.

Dog Days …  Just my luck to discover a Dog Boarding that actually respects dogs and lets them be dogs late in my dogs life . The staff is amazing friendly and caring I have a very big dog an Alaskan Malamute he’s 150 pounds of love , Dog Days evaluates every dog for there mannerism and how well they interact with other dogs just to make sure everyone gets along as they believe in an open environment for the dogs to interact without stress of being confined . At the end of the day dogs are more happier but most importantly owners are Satisfied knowing there dog was well cared for. A Big Woof to Dog Days .

I’ve had some horrifying experiences with Dog boarding at Veterinary Hospital that have Licensed Veterinarians full time and trained staff … one would think such places would be cream of the crop , you would be surprised.

We took are dog here while we went on vacation for two weeks. When we pick up are dog at the end of the two weeks they they told us that are dog has been tired the past couple of days, when we took are dog home he was coughing nonstop and was not eating or moving at all. He was just laying in the middle of the room, he has never done that before, so we took him to the vet and they said that he had pneumonia and had to do x rays and bloodwork and had to get antibiotics so on top of the 100 dollars you pay a night at dog day expect to pay 1500 for medical bills after.
Karma loves to go to DD!! She enjoys all of the doggie friends she’s made and especially the staff🩷

Cooper was excited once he got there and ran off immediately to go play. The employees there are so nice and he was exhausted when he got home.
I like that there is a little story to watch on IG to see how the dogs are doing.
Much appreciated. See you guys again soon. 😁

What can I say about Dog Days that probably hasn't been said before! It's an amazing place, you can feel confident your babies are in good hands.

My senior dog used to go to their old location and we recently started bringing our new puppy to this newer location.

All staff I have met have been wonderful. Your first day needs to be an evaluation to see how your dog reacts. They place them appropriately in each room based on temperament and size as well I believe. And every few months if your pup hasn't been attending they do require a re-evaluation.

My puppy can be nervous as she's trying to get over some reactivity and coming here has helped her grow too. They put things in place to help her adjust and go at her pace. They have other services they offer, like training as well, which we will also be trying out soon.

Thank you Dog Days for always being so great with our pups!

Update: 2026
We can’t say “dog days” out loud at home without our dogs getting the zoomies in anticipation. They’ve spent 1 night to 10 nights and we have never felt more secure with our dogs safety and care. The staff is always accommodating to any needs for our pups and communication is on point. As long as we are in San Diego, Dog Days is our choice hands down.

Took our dog in for their first free day eval - very clean, professional and large facility. Report card at the end of the day with detail is a nice touch.
My dog does both daycare and boarding. He LOVES Dog Days! They take great care of him. The staff is friendly and responsive. I’ve been coming for 2 years and I’ve never had a bad experience.
We just love it here!❤️🐾
Sadie loves her time at Dog Days!  The staff is the best!! We thank everyone for making Sadie feel happy and loved!
Always a good experience at Dog Days. My pup is well cared for and the staff is great. Dog Days makes life better for me and my pup!

My dog has been going to Dog Days for about 4 years now. My dog STILL LOVES it there. He is just as excited when we hit the parking lot, as he was on his first day going. His weekly hikes are his favorite time. The entire staff is wonderful with him and attentive to ALL the dogs. They really do treat your dog as if they are their own. The wellbeing and health of the dogs attending is paramount. Highly recommend this facility.
Everyone here is so attentive and really enjoy their jobs. They answer all my questions every time I call

Amazing!! Can’t speak highly enough about this place. Storm has been coming since he was 6 months old and he loves every second of his time here. The staff is also SO welcoming and friendly. Can’t wait to bring my lil guy back again :) The grooming services are also great !

We absolutely love Dog Days Daycare! Koko has the best time every time she goes. Whether we have a long day at work or we’re heading out of town for a quick trip, we know she’s in great hands.

The staff is always so kind, welcoming, and genuinely cares about the dogs. We especially love seeing the updates on Instagram and getting her report card. It always makes our day to see what she’s been up to and how much fun she’s having.

The best part is how excited Koko gets when we tell her she’s going to camp! She can’t wait to get there, and by the time she comes home she’s completely worn out from a day full of play and friends. We couldn’t ask for a better place to take our girl. Highly recommend!

Our sweet Tawny has been coming here for the past six years, and I can't imagine taking her anywhere else. The fact that she never hesitates to jump out of the car and run inside tells me everything I need to know about how she's treated when we're not there.

As pet parents, we've had an equally wonderful experience. Check-in and check-out are always smooth, friendly, and efficient. We've also use their bathing, nail trim, and pack walk services, and every experience has been exceptional. One of my favorite parts is seeing the daily photos and social media shout-outs. It's such a thoughtful touch that lets us see Tawny having fun and enjoying her day with her furry friends.

The entire team genuinely cares about the dogs, and it shows in everything they do. We feel incredibly fortunate to have found them, and after six years, we can confidently say they've become an important part of Tawny's life. Thank you for loving our girl as much as we do!

Gigi has been going to Dog Days twice a week for the past several months.  The staff is wonderful and welcoming.  I feel like they truly care about Gigi and take great care of her.  We get lick puzzles on most visits and they trim her nails regularly.  She is very happy at Dog Days.

My go to for stays for my dog when I’m out of town. We call it the doggie Taj Mahal. They do a great job of informing me of how he’s doing and he’s always tired when I come pick him up, which means he’s having a great time playing with the other dogs.

We LOVE dog days.  My two 8 year old labs have been going to Dog Days since they were about 2 years old.  We started using them as a way to get out all that puppy energy and we have stuck around because of the amazing care they provide.  Dog Days is always a safe reliable place for my dogs to spend their time when I am going to be out of town or out of the house for the whole day.  The staff there truly love dogs and do such a great job making sure that all the pups are well loved, exercised, and monitored for the entire day.  Their staff are also just such incredible resources for all dog related questions.  We have gotten some amazing advice and recommendations for everything from training, to food, to vet services, to behavioral issues.

Our dogs absolutely love Dog Days.  They have learned social skills, enjoyed sleep overs, dog training lessons and just good ol’ fun.    Consistently wonderful staff is so rare.  We never worry at all when our “boys” are there.  Highly recommend.
THOR, came home exhausted so playtime was good! As always staff was attentive and responsive.

So this place is a godsend. We rescued a 6 month old puppy and started her here for needed reprieves. Much like everyone else has said Dog Days does it really well on all accounts. The staff is always amazing. Super service oriented, personable, knowledgeable and kind. The cost for half days and full days is so reasonable. They are so consistent and our dog Zen just loves going here. She never looks back when I take her. Many of the folks that go to the nearby dog park take their dogs here. Their first time intake process is thoughtful and caring to ensure good and safe experiences for all that use their service. Would not hesitate to send your puppy here. It’s clear the ownership is detail oriented and great at oversight and training. Love you guys. Martha, Michael and Zen.

I love Dog Days! And more importantly, my dogs (Chewbacca and Rocky Rafiki) do too!! The staff here clearly care about dogs and their humans. They are kind, compassionate, patient, and seem to know all of the dogs by name. One of my pups is a little shy and anxious and they took the time to make sure he was comfortable. They go into daycare confidently and leave tired and happy.

We’ve also used the pickup and dropoff process and it was seamless.

They have great add-ons and grooming services. We’ve done it all. And I love that the owner isn’t afraid to take a stand for what she believes in! 5 stars for Dog Days!

My 5 yr old Belgian Malinois had a great time. He really benefited from the pack hike.
He's been going there since he was a wee pup. Its the only place I trust his vare and boarding to. And I love that I can have him groomed before picking him up. The staff is so friendly and knowledgeable. I also love how clean the facility is.

My velcro dog can’t leave me fast enough when we enter Dog Days! He started daycare regularly as a puppy over 5 years ago and I attribute a lot of his socialization skills to Dog Days. He learned how to play, communicate, and understand different behaviors. Whether it’s a day of play or overnight boarding, I know that my guy is happy & safe. The staff is always so friendly and goes above and beyond for any range of questions you may have. I can’t recommend this place enough!
Your dog will like this place more than he/she likes you. Mine loves it like a second home.
My pup had a great time. Came home happy and tired. The front desk staff are very nice!!

This place is truly amazing. We wouldn’t trust anyone else to watch our dog. They always provide updates, which gives us total peace of mind knowing our dog is in great hands. The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming, and they take the time to really get to know your dog and understand their individual needs 💕

Dog days is soooo legit. They've been watching my baby dog for 2.5 years now--since she was 6 months old. They've helped us through her bitey puppy phase, her rambunctious adolescent phase and they still love her and talk sweet to her every time we drop her off. The people here are friendly, knowledgeable and you can tell they all bust their asses to provide such excellent service. I'm proud to take my dog here and I hope they are all proud of the work they do--it's outstanding!!

We’ve attempted to drop off our dog several times now. Google always says it’s open. And their Instagram shows them active posting on their story but every time we show up, there’s a sign on the door that says closed. It’s a Thursday at 11:30am.

Its a great place and my Dog loves it. They are always welcome and friendly. Easy to communicate. Always ready to answer to all my questions. Keep eye on a dog and if something  they let you know right the way. ALL staff are very supportive and really care about the dog!
This place is awesome. My dog can’t wait to get there and is sad when it’s time to go home. Highly recommend

Truly the best place I could imagine for my dog. My dog can be a little nervous, but she loves the staff and I can completely trust them to put her at ease (and help her have fun!) The entire staff have gone above and beyond for my dog over the past few years, but especially the last 18 months or so when I had to travel suddenly or change plans multiple times during a family crisis. During this last stay, they also took my girl to the vet and took care of her while she needed some extra TLC. I'm so grateful to have found them!

Dog Days San Diego is our favorite place to have our 20 pound mixed dog go for day care and boarding!  It is obvious that the staff love dogs and are familiar with dogs with responding to their various personalities and behaviors.  Our dog loves to goes twice a week and enjoys her time to play with other dogs and get attention from the humans.
Recommended by my dog trainer and absolutely will recommend to others. Thoughtful, individualized approach to my dog and his 1st day there, staff very professional, friendly and competent.

Absolutely without a doubt the best place you could take your dog for daycare boarding. My Oso, who I had to put down last night after 14 years has been going Dog Days since they were downtown for the last 13+ years. They are the most amazingly caring human beings I would ever trust with my dog. Whether it was giving him socialization, training, treats, meals, taking him to an emergency vet appointment, giving him snuggles and hugs, and just overall keeping me updated when I was traveling about his health and his well-being, I couldn’t ask for a better group of people these last 13+ years. They set such a high bar that I wouldn’t trust anybody else to watch my dog, and I feel so honored and blessed that he got to experience the love of so many people over these last years at Dog Days and interact with so many wonderful dogs and live the best, healthiest and Fulfilling life that I could ever want for him. I am just so grateful for the entire Dog Days staff.

Such a great experience re: day care! I was referred to Dog Days from a close friend and will absolutely return. The staff were so kind, especially Taylor who helped us check-in, and were accessible for a check-in via phone. They also send a daily report via email! My pup had a great day.

My Dog’s Second Home!

Dog Days has truly become my dog’s favorite place in the world! From the moment we pull into the parking lot, she’s already wagging her tail and can’t wait to run in. The team there is so kind, attentive, and genuinely loves every dog that walks through the door.

My dog has done it all — daycare, boarding, pack hikes, and even the monthly luxury bath experience — and she always comes home happy, calm, and beautifully clean. The staff knows her personality so well and gives her the perfect mix of play, rest, and love.

I also love that they offer daily treats and healthy goodies for purchase; she has a few favorites I always grab when we pick her up. It’s clear the entire Dog Days team puts so much care into what they do, and I trust them completely with my girl.

Dog Days is so good to her I can’t even say the word “daycare” without her rushing me to the door. She’s made so many friends, and the staff, and the trainer have really boosted her confidence as a young puppy.

Thank you for creating such a safe, fun, and loving space for our pups! 🐶💛

I was worried about leaving my 2 year old Cavalier at a daycare for the first time. Although she is sweet and social, she does have some mild separation anxiety. She also does not prefer to play with other dogs. But, the staff was very patient with her and tried to refocus her when appearing a little anxious. I was very pleased and will use them again.

We tried a new dog daycare today and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Bruno had his trial day and it went so well. From the moment we arrived, he seemed comfortable and at ease, which says a lot because he can sometimes be a little hesitant in new environments. The staff was incredibly attentive, and the notes they shared with me at the end of the day were so thoughtful and detailed, it really gave me confidence that they were paying close attention to him throughout the day. It’s such a relief to know he’s in a place where he feels safe, cared for, and happy. I’m really excited for him to go back!

I wrote some time ago that Dog Days “Best staff ever. Each and every one treats our pup Rowan and all of his people like family!”  Rowan is no longer a puppy but he still thinks (and we agree) that his Dog Days family are the smartest, friendliest, and all around best he ask for🦮 …

Dog Days is wonderful for our pup Ruby - we use them mostly for overnight boarding. The staff there has been nothing but attentive and kind, and Ruby gets SO EXCITED when we pull into the parking lot. They also do a wonderful job with her baths/grooming at the end of her stays. Very grateful to have found them!

Everyone was very friendly and informative. I love the report card and pictures. It’s a perfect daycare for my fur baby❤️
Update April 3-6, my fur baby stay 3 nights, because my daughter’s wedding. I was so nervous to leave him but the girls at Dog Days reassured me that he will be fine and I could call each day to check on him. I know he was well cared for cause after that event, he walks in there with no hesitation.
We brought our pups to Dog Days during a short visit to San Diego. The people working there are so kind and attentive - we received a thorough report after the visit. Highly recommended.
Super friendly. My dog was tired but seemed like he had fun according g to his report card.

Very attentive, responsive.
I scheduled by email since I'm not a member, I'm the dog sitter this week.
Again, clear and responded early in morning to my late night email.
Better yet - dog was happy trotting in, and happy at pick up.
Wonderful staff who take good care of your best friend

We absolutely love this place. It was recommended by our trainer at Pack Method Prep which is another great resource. I have 6 month old puppy pitbull husky mix. He is large he needs exercise and he is very timid so he needs some confidence. I appreciate he can play despite not being neutered yet due to his age. He loves dogs and people and gets interaction from both. They are all dog loving here everyone is always so happy to see him. It’s a really great safe place to bring your pup. Since starting daycare days a couple times a week it’s made such a difference. He is calmer, more confident and oddly stopped having potty accidents completely. He loves being with his family and hated his one boarding experience but I pick him up so happy here. Best thing we started doing. Plus my older dog appreciates the break from puppy and he is passed out after a day here!
*Update: we have also used their bath service here and boarding now. The first time he was boarded (not at Dog Days) he was very distressed when I picked him up and took awhile to be himself. Boarding here he had so much fun and came home happy & exhausted. He was nervous sleeping there and was able to sleep by the human onsite to settle down. The detailed report card of his stay made me feel so confident in his care while I was away and shows just how much their staff loves and cares for the dogs. I cannot recommend them more. They have worked with me through puppy & teen behavior. Rocky runs straight back when we get here and absolutely loves it.

Dog Days San Diego has been an absolute lifesaver for us for almost two years now, primarily for our boarding needs when we travel. We've used them countless times, and our trust in them is unwavering. Every stay is met with thorough report cards and a flood of adorable photos, making us feel connected even when we're away. They are also incredibly responsive and always reach out with updates or concerns. Our dogs always return home happy, healthy, and clearly well-loved. The staff is exceptional – genuinely knowledgeable and clearly well-trained, which is crucial for our peace of mind. The only minor thing we've missed is a live webcam feed, which is something we've been used to at other places. However, we've noticed that most SoCal facilities don't offer this, so it might be a regional regulation. Ultimately, Dog Days San Diego is an outstanding boarding and daycare provider, and we wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone who wants the best care for their furry family members.

Our dog enjoys her time at dog days! Her social skills with other dogs has improved from tolerating them to being happy to see them! And the staff are so kind by giving a thorough report card and pictures.
My dog loves it here

My boy was a bit shy during his evaluation/first day, but everyone at Dog Days made his stay as comfortable as they could! Excited to see him grow out of his shell thanks to Dog Days! (he looks a bit freaked out in the first photo, but he was fine!)

Impeccable service! Very thorough and they just love dogs! The first day pictures and report card are incredibly cute!
PS my puppy of 5 months is actually tired?!!!

We started taking our Bernedoodle here when he was a puppy. He is a big guy but was a little skittish with it being his first time at daycare. They started him out with the smaller dogs where he felt more comfortable. After a few sessions, he came out of his shell and they were able to transition him to the big dog room. They did such a great job making sure he acclimated. He loves going to  daycare and overnight boarding here. When he stays overnight they always update me if he goes on hunger strike (always) and offer to put tasty morsels in his food. Highly recommend the lick puzzle!

My dog Odie went today for the first time! He seemed to have had so much fun and now he’s resting. The only thing I wish was they closed at 8 so that I could come after work. I work 7-730 and live too far for the shuttle service. I will definitely keep them in mind for days I’m off but not available to be with him all day or if I’m going out of town. Thank you all for great hospitality and taking great care of my boy!

Everyone we met at Dog Days Pacific Beach was pleasant and efficient. Our dog was seen for a first visit assessment and they sent cute pics. Then he stayed for two full days after that. All went well.

The team at Dog Days San Diego are amazing and treat my babies like one of their own.  I am able to relax on our trips because I know my pups are taken care of.  They offer pack hikes, so it's like Shadow and Kaia are on their own vacation.  I can message them to get updates and photos

After taking our boy Preston to another doggy day care that told us we needed more training before we could bring him back, we brought him to Dog Days. After the first day of leaving him here we were so happy. The Dog Days staff gave us such detailed information on Preston’s stay. They showed so much care and on top of that Preston was so worn out from playing, he rested for a couple days after over night boarding.  This is good because being Husky mix, he has an extreme amount of endless energy.

We have trusted Dog Days with multiple nights of overnight boarding as we have had to go out of town or work late. Preston gets so excited when we are a block away to go play with his friends at Dog Days. It’s so nice that when our work schedule gets hectic we can take him to Dog Days and know he is going to be so well taken care of and have such a good time. Dog Days has been a godsend for all of us, including Preston.

We are forever thankful!!

They were also able to trim his nails which he is very sensitive about. We were almost out of options and they got it done. Dog Days has many additional services from Dog walks to Grooming as well.

Do not hesitate to take your dog here for day care or over night boarding.
This place is amazing, the staff is super friendly and helpful and my dog has a ball!

This is hands down the best doggy day care and overnight boarding in San Diego. Our 2 rescue pups have come here several times over the last few years, for as long as 6 nights, and every time I’m blown away by the level of care provided.

One of our dogs is super friendly, while the other is much more shy and still getting used to strangers and other dogs. Our shy dog needs to be with her sister at all times, and isn’t always the best at communicating her feelings - and Dog Days always provides us with thorough updates on how she’s doing and accommodates her little quirks (like needing to be in the small dog area despite being 50 pounds, ha) to make sure she’s doing well & that all the other dogs are comfortable too.

We’ve also used their transportation drop off service, and there was a hiccup once where our shy dog was having some barrier aggression when getting into the van. Rather than throwing their hands up and asking us to come get her, DD gave her and her sister a PRIVATE ride home - we were obviously a bit mortified but so relieved that DD handled the situation so well for all dogs involved. They gave us a robust rundown of the situation and recommendations for how to handle similar issues in the future.

And whenever we call to check in as anxious dog parents, they always give us detailed notes on their behavior and health as well. We also love that they have extracurriculars for the dogs, like hiking outings, too!

Dog Days is truly the most professional level of dog care you can get in San Diego - and while the rates do reflect that, it’s absolutely worth the peace of mind. Ziggy and Nova say thank you!!
My girl Zeaux loves this place. Staff is always nice and she sleeps well when she gets home 💗 …
